content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #230 in Moneo: the review flow for categorizing transactions. The owner wants all three:
1. **Bulk "apply to all"**: one action to set one category for every row in a group (or for all remaining rows), and a way to skip the step entirely, for an owner who doesn't want to categorize one by one.
2. **One pass**: show every pending item up front. Today the owner finishes, closes it, and finds more feedback waiting, again and again. Find out why items appear in batches (pagination, a background job adding more, a limit) and fix the cause so the owner sees everything in one go.
3. **Edit after deciding**: a category already given can be changed again, from the review list and from the transaction.
Owner category choices are owner corrections. Keep history and undo (AGENTS.md). Note: a sibling agent is working on #231 (removing the "add a merchant" prompt), so stay focused on categories and avoid touching merchant-prompt code.

## Rules for every child
- Repo: Moneo (indkhan/Moneo). Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly (no comments in code, surgical changes, tests only for real behaviour, hit every surface, desktop + source install both work).
- Read the full GitHub issue first: `gh issue view <n> --comments`. Recheck the current tree before changing anything; reproduce first.
- Work only in your own worktree. Create a branch `t3/issue-<n>-<short-slug>` from current `origin/main` (`git fetch origin && git switch -c <branch> origin/main`). Commit each step in plain language, ending each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- Other agents are working in parallel on other issues against the SAME shared moneo-qa test backend and QA app port 3100. So: never run `npm run qa:reset`, never `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`, never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, Docker project `moneo`). Set up the state your test needs with disposable users or rows you create and remove. If port 3100 is already serving another checkout, wait and retry later; never kill a process you didn't start.
- Mock AI, bank and Scalable. No real paid calls.
- Before finishing: `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`; plus `npm run build` for app/config changes; for UI changes use the verify-ui skill (light/dark/mobile screenshots) and attach the evidence to the PR.
- Push and open a PR to `main` with `gh pr create`, body: what changed and why, `Closes #<n>`, how it was verified. End the PR body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge. Don't create a new GitHub issue unless work is truly deferred.
- If a decision is genuinely ambiguous beyond what's written here, pick the option that best fits AGENTS.md, note it in the PR body, and continue.
- Final line of your reply: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

PR #249 is open: the Home "transactions need a category" sheet now has bulk apply, shows everything in one pass, and lets a category be changed afterwards.

The new browser journey, lint, typecheck, build and bundle check pass. Full `npm test` has 7 failures in 6 files: 5-second timeouts in `lib/cron.test.ts` and other heavy page tests that this change doesn't touch. I read this as machine load (the same cron timeouts as #246) and did not re-run them on `main` to confirm.

- **Bulk:** an "Everything left" box applies one category to every remaining group, and "Skip all" leaves them untouched. Typed new categories are created once, however many groups are involved.
- **One pass:** items arrived in batches for two reasons.
  - The sheet loaded only the 1,000 newest rows and showed only the 30 biggest groups. It now loads and shows every group.
  - Applying a category silently skipped rows the organizer wouldn't propose a label for, then counted them as done. Those rows came back on the next visit. Every selected row is now categorized.
- **Edit after deciding:** a categorized or skipped group shows "Change" or "Categorize", which applies the new category against the current row versions. Editing from the transaction drawer already worked and is unchanged.

Owner choices still go through the existing review and apply functions, so they stay owner corrections with history and undo. There is no migration and no desktop-specific change.

I added `e2e/home-categorize.gated.spec.ts`: a disposable user with 36 groups (more than the old 30-group cap) gets all groups shown, all 72 rows categorized in one apply, then one group changed. It passes against the QA backend. I also checked the sheet at desktop light, desktop dark and 390px mobile, before and after applying. The screenshots are in `.qa/shots/issue230/`, which is git-ignored, so they are not attached to the PR yet.

"Skip all" only affects the open sheet. The Home card still returns while rows are uncategorized, because a persistent dismissal would need new stored state; I noted this in the PR body.
